headline: Renesas lists AMS/DMS verification roles spanning power ICs, reusable models, UVM and correlation
fact: Renesas listed PMIC verification roles for battery chargers, switching regulators and analog power IP. The descriptions cover chip-level AMS and full-chip DMS, SystemVerilog RNM and Verilog-AMS models integrated with RTL and UVM, model correlation to specifications and schematics, coverage closure, sign-off and silicon bench correlation. A later Kodaira staff listing assigns reusable UVM environments, assertions, checkers and coverage, and requests RNM/Verilog-AMS modeling experience for bias networks, regulators, bandgaps, amplifiers, comparators, converters and other mixed-signal blocks. Its requisition carries August 27, while its page's JobPosting datePosted is September 17; it does not establish an August public-posting date.
